static.不改写原文件 · 不运行宏或公式: Original files unchanged · No macros or formula execution
static.粘贴包含 SN 与左右字段的 Excel 表格: Paste an Excel table containing SN and adjacent fields
static.已按原始记录核对非文本单元格及其前导零，确认可以使用。: I have checked non-text cells and leading zeros against the original records.
static.导入，开始出码: Import a list to generate codes
static.选择文件 → 确认 SN 列 → 连续切换: Choose a file → Confirm the SN column → Step through codes
static.当前 SN 及同一行左右字段: Current SN and fields from the same row
static.查看同一行全部字段: Show all fields in this row
static.数值按源值显示；公式仅显示已有缓存值，未重新计算。空白和合并单元格不自动补值。: Numbers show source values. Formulas show cached values without recalculation. Blank and merged cells are not filled automatically.
static.等待导入。可先点击「试用示例」。: Waiting for import. Try Example to get started.
static.切换前，请确认扫码完成。: Confirm the scan is complete before moving on.
static.解锁左侧列条形码: Stop keeping left column barcode enabled
static.解锁右侧列条形码: Stop keeping right column barcode enabled
static.选择表头定位列: Choose a column by its header
static.可多选图片，或在此页粘贴、拖入图片。识别后按原码制生成 PNG。: Choose multiple images, or paste or drop images here. Generate PNGs in each detected barcode format.
static.支持常见二维码及 Code 128、Code 39、EAN、UPC 等条形码。模: Supports QR codes and common barcodes including Code 128, Code 39, EAN and UPC. Blurred, obscured or small codes may be missed; check the count and contents. Duplicate labels are kept separately. Up to 255 codes per image; crop large images into smaller sections.
static.文件名使用码内文本，非法字符替换为下划线，过长名称截短，重名追加序号；编码内容保: Filenames use the decoded text. Invalid characters become underscores, long names are shortened, and duplicate names receive a number. Encoded contents remain unchanged. Images are processed locally. Limit: 50 MB and 24 megapixels per image.
static.整张 .xlsx 或连续多列一起导入，才能显示 SN 左右字段。只粘贴 SN 一: Import an .xlsx file or consecutive columns to show fields beside the SN. Adjacent fields cannot be recovered from an SN-only paste. Pasted row and column numbers start at the pasted range; import .xlsx to keep original Excel coordinates.
static.自动识别只处理当前工作表：优先查找前 50 个非空行中的 SN、S/N、序列号等: Detection uses only the current sheet. It searches the first 50 non-empty rows for SN headers, then uses content patterns if no header is found. Choose manually when there are multiple candidates. Detection does not validate manufacturer serial numbers or require 14 characters.
static.左右卡片始终取同一行的紧邻列，不跨过空白列找其他值。展开「同一行全部列」可看更远: Side cards initially show adjacent columns from the same row. Use the arrows or header menus to choose other columns. Missing values and column boundaries are marked; merged cells are not filled automatically.
static.SN 列请先设为「文本」，再填写或粘贴。已损失的前导零或长数字末位无法恢复。SN: Set the SN column to Text before entering values. Lost leading zeros or digits cannot be recovered. Paste SN formulas as values first. Other columns show raw or cached values without recalculation or custom date/currency formatting.
static.保留顺序、重复值、大小写和首尾空格；只跳过 SN 为空的行。隐藏或被筛选掉的行仍: Order, duplicates, case and surrounding spaces are preserved. Only empty SN rows are skipped. Hidden and filtered rows are still read; copy the required rows and consecutive columns to process a subset.
static.文件不超过 10 MB；最多 20,000 个源行、512 列、10,000 条: Limit: 10 MB, 20,000 source rows, 512 columns and 10,000 serial numbers. Supports unencrypted .xlsx and UTF-8 CSV / TXT / TSV. Legacy .xls, password-protected and macro-enabled workbooks are not supported.
static.Code 128 B 支持 1–80 个可打印 ASCII 字符；二维码 / 纯: Code 128 B supports 1–80 printable ASCII characters; QR and text images support up to 512 characters. Generated images contain only the original SN. Adjacent fields are excluded and S/N: prefixes are neither added nor removed.
static.更改工作表、SN 列、表头行或起始行会停止旧清单，需重新点击「开始显示」，避免用: Changing the sheet, SN column, header row or first data row stops the current list. Check the preview and click Start again. Refreshing or closing clears data and progress. Excel files are never modified.
static.切换不等于扫码成功。本工具不接收业务系统回执，正式使用前请用少量已知 SN 测试: Moving to the next code does not confirm a successful scan. This tool does not receive business-system acknowledgements. Test a few known serial numbers before regular use.
static.已取消，已生成的图片仍可保存: Cancelled; generated images can still be saved
static.图片超过 2400 万像素，请裁剪后导入: Image exceeds 24 megapixels; crop it before importing
static.识别引擎无法运行，请使用新版 Chrome 或 Edge: Scanner could not start; use a recent Chrome or Edge
static.请检查清晰度，或裁剪后重试: Check image clarity, or crop and try again
static.此码暂不能按原格式生成: This code cannot be regenerated in its original format
static.行数超过 20,000，请拆分清单。: More than 20,000 rows; split the list.
static.文本中存在未闭合的双引号，请检查 CSV 格式。: Unclosed double quote; check the CSV format.
static.不支持 ZIP64 或分卷文件。: ZIP64 and split archives are not supported.
static.工作簿内部文件过多，请另存为仅包含 SN 的新工作簿。: Too many workbook entries; save a new workbook containing only the required list.
static.工作簿解压内容过大，请仅保留 SN 清单后重试。: Workbook expands beyond the size limit; keep only the required list.
static.此浏览器不能直接读取 .xlsx。请用新版 Chrome / Edge，或复制: This browser cannot read .xlsx directly. Use a recent Chrome / Edge or paste the required Excel columns.
static.解压内容超过安全限额。: Decompressed contents exceed the safety limit.
static.文件完整性校验失败，请重新保存 Excel 后重试。: File integrity check failed; save the Excel file again and retry.
static.工作簿无可用工作表，或工作表数量超过 64。: No usable sheets, or more than 64 sheets.
static.有数据的列超出第 512 列，请复制所需连续列后粘贴。: Data extends beyond column 512; paste only the required consecutive columns.
static.有数据的行超出 20,000 行，请仅复制所需 SN 后粘贴。: Data extends beyond row 20,000; paste only the required rows.
static.数据源已更换，请核对范围后开始显示。: Data source changed; check the range before starting.
static.SN 定位已更改，请核对新范围后开始显示。: SN mapping changed; check the new range before starting.
static.已重新识别 SN 位置，请核对后开始显示。: SN column detected again; check it before starting.
static.没有找到可靠的 SN 位置。请手动选择 SN 所在列、表头行和数据起始行。不会默: No reliable SN column found. Select the SN column, header row and first data row manually. The first column is not selected automatically.
static.已读取范围超过 512 列，请只保留所需列后重新导入。: More than 512 columns; keep only the required columns and import again.
static.所选工作表没有可用数据。: The selected sheet has no usable data.
static.导入列或行范围已更改，请核对预览后点击「开始显示」。: Column or row range changed; check the preview and click Start.
static.请输入有效列号，或从列表中选择。: Enter a valid column number or select one from the list.
static.SN 列号超出已读取范围。: SN column is outside the imported range.
static.起始行应为 1–20,000 的整数。: First data row must be an integer from 1 to 20,000.
static.表头行应为 0（无表头），或小于数据起始行的正整数。: Header row must be 0 (none) or a positive integer before the first data row.
static.原文自带 SN / S/N 前缀，编码也会保留；请核对是否属于原始 SN: Original SN / S/N prefix is preserved in the code; check whether it belongs to the serial number
static.原单元格为数值，请核对前导零: Source cell is numeric; check leading zeros
static.超过 10,000 条，请拆分清单。: More than 10,000 records; split the list.
static.SN 已在第一列: SN is in the first column
static.SN 已在已读取范围的最右列: SN is in the last imported column
static.没有可显示的 SN，请检查列和起始行。: No SN to display; check the column and first data row.
static.文件超过 10 MB。请只保留需要的表格范围后重试。: File exceeds 10 MB; keep only the required range and retry.
static.请把文本另存为 UTF-8 编码后再导入，或直接复制 Excel 中的多列后粘贴: Save the text as UTF-8, or copy and paste consecutive Excel columns.

static.请粘贴 SN 清单，或包含 SN 及左右字段的多列表格。: Paste an SN list or a table with SN and adjacent fields.
static.粘贴内容过大，请分批处理。: Pasted content is too large; split it into smaller batches.
static.· 行列号按粘贴区域重新计数；保留 Excel 原坐标请导入 .xlsx。: · Row and column numbers start at the pasted range; import .xlsx to keep original coordinates.
static.Code 128 B 模式仅支持 1–80 个可打印英文 / 数字 / ASCI: Code 128 B requires 1–80 printable ASCII characters. For Chinese or longer text, choose QR or text image.
static.已到最后一条；不会自动返回第一条。: Last record; the list does not wrap automatically.
static.已发起 PNG 保存（只含 SN，不含左右字段）；保存结果以浏览器为准。: PNG download started (SN only, no adjacent fields). Check your browser downloads.
